title: StarImage
description: starimagesouthlake.com StarImage Dental Boutique & Oral Surgery is a premium dental practice in Southlake, Texas, opened in January 2021 as the second location of StarImage Dentistry founded by Dr. James Green in Wichita Falls over 25 years ago. Led by Dr. Green, oral surgeon Dr. Dustin Van Tassell and Dr. Susan Millner, it offers cosmetic and reconstructive dentistry, dental implants, full mouth rehabilitation, oral surgery, TMJ treatment and sleep apnea care all under one roof. The clinic is one of the most technologically advanced dental offices in the US, equipped with Planmeca ProMax 3D CBCT imaging, MLS laser therapy, VELscope cancer screening and CT-guided implant surgery. Both lead doctors hold Fellow status at the Las Vegas Institute for Advanced Dental Studies, and the practice maintains a perfect 5.0 rating across 50 plus reviews. Its dedicated TMJ and Sleep Center provides a high-margin specialization in jaw disorders and obstructive sleep apnea.
